title: Pakistan Plans $500 Million Bond Raise in China for 2027
excerpt: Pakistan is preparing to secure $500 million from China's domestic bond market in 2027 without global bank guarantees.
body_html:
Pakistan is making preparations to secure $500 million through China's domestic bond market. The planned fundraising effort is scheduled for 2027.

According to the details, the government is aiming to obtain this fresh financing without relying on global bank guarantees.
